hooks.command:
in=$(cat)
cmd=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""')
fp=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""')
if printf '%s %s' "$cmd" "$fp" | grep -oE '\.env[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*' | grep -vE '^\.environment' | grep -ivqE '^\.env\.(example|sample|template|dist|defaults?)$'; then
  printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Security hook: this references a .env secret file. Reading secrets into the transcript/model context is blocked. Use .env.example, or extract a single non-secret value deliberately."}}'
fi
